summary: The session discusses best practices for implementing a data catalog, highlighting the challenges organizations face in adoption and usage. It emphasizes the importance of metadata management, communication with stakeholders, and aligning data governance with business outcomes. The speaker outlines key use cases for data catalogs, including searchability, data governance, data engineering, and AI readiness.

key_points: Understanding the purpose of a data catalog
Searchability as a primary use case

key_takeaways: Engage stakeholders early to ensure alignment and understanding of the data catalog's purpose.
Focus on high-value use cases to drive organic growth and adoption of the data catalog.
Establish clear metadata standards and provide training to enhance metadata quality and usability.
